_comment: DEMO ONLY — the `universe` + `triggers` subset of config/config.example.yaml for standalone tevnnis-md runs. Core owns the authored YAML configuration; this file is not a second source of truth and must not drift into one.

md._news_comment: Live news poller (--news-source longbridge only). The Longbridge news endpoint takes one symbol per call and has no `since` cursor, and news is exempt from the four §4.4 quote-throttling knobs — so max_age_minutes and max_items_per_symbol are the only bound on news volume.
